description:
Hey! I’m working on the Lunar Landing Site Navigator challenge building a tool that helps visualize sunlight and Earth-visibility windows at candidate Artemis south pole landing sites so mission planners can quickly compare sites and dates.

I’ve been digging into the NASA datasets (LOLA terrain, JPL Horizons API) and have a solid understanding of what the challenge is asking for. I’m interested in 3D visualization, and building tools that make complex data easy to understand.
